patches.value: The exact prepared lean_header is retained as a prefix; its category-1 dependencies have no provisional E ports in this source. All six H roots are retained; M results are used directly from Mathlib. The highest weight remains an integer; ell=Int.toNat lam is identified with it only using H003. Idx lam=Fin(ell+1) indexes 0 through ell; natural subtraction occurs only in source natural indices, while eigenvalue subtraction is performed in ℂ after casting (equivalently the source integer expression). Endomorphism multiplication is composition with the rightmost map acting first. ev is defined at every natural index so guarded off-range expressions need no fabricated Fin element. M is a genuine integer submodule of the original complex V and is not the minimal lattice. Its paired basis in H006 has size ell+1; under H003 and the finite dimension H004 this is equivalent to the original unrestricted paired-basis condition by reindexing. H004 explicitly retains finite dimension and complex irreducibility, expressed as the invariant-subspace dichotomy for the generators; H005 retains all highest-weight and Chevalley equations. latticeEnd restricts when preservation holds and defaults to zero otherwise, making the object definition total without assuming preservation: T002 must prove preservation and agreement with each original operator. TensorLeft=K⊗ℤM uses the native left-factor K-action. TensorRight=M⊗ℤK keeps the original abelian group and receives its K-action via the additive balanced swap; T011 proves that this is precisely scalar multiplication on the K factor and that induced lattice maps have the prescribed pure-tensor action. Thus the two actual representations are connected by a checked conversion, then T004 transports the matrix units and dimension to the original order. Nontrivial is nonzeroness; bottom/top are zero/whole subspaces. Background notes remain node-local references, never new assumptions. The two universes uK/uV are public object universes; N005 additionally uses its own named universes and T006 records its application at K and TensorRight K M.
